items.question: How do I set up inventory and receive payouts?
items.answer: Register your inventory by adding screen specifications, geo-coordinates, and operating hours in the Vendor Dashboard. Once verified, link your business bank account or digital wallet. Verified earnings are disbursed automatically following campaign completion and proof-of-play validation.

items.question: Can I customize my rates and operating hours?
items.answer: Yes. You maintain complete control over base rates, peak-hour surcharges, minimum booking durations, and blackout dates through dynamic scheduling rules.

items.question: Can I manually review and approve campaign bookings?
items.answer: Absolutely. You can toggle between programmatic auto-acceptance for verified advertisers or manual review mode where each creative asset and schedule requires your explicit approval before going live.

items.question: Which creative formats are supported across screens?
items.answer: Di-Wrapp supports high-resolution static images (PNG, JPEG, WebP), dynamic HTML5 interactive formats, and ultra-high-definition video (MP4, MOV up to 4K resolution) optimized for DOOH displays.

items.question: Is there a minimum number of screens required to join?
items.answer: There is no minimum requirement. Whether you manage a single retail storefront display or a regional network of hundreds of digital billboards, you can monetize your inventory seamlessly on Di-Wrapp.

items.question: How are taxes and commercial invoices handled?
items.answer: All commercial invoices, tax receipts, and payment statements are generated automatically per campaign and are exportable anytime directly from your billing dashboard in full compliance with ZATCA regulations.
